topic: Google stole open source code without crediting the authors (Artemis/Minitap)
headline: Google's Open Source Controversy
caption: As a full stack engineer, I know how much respect and transparency matter when working with open source. This situation with Google highlights the importance of respecting developer rights and giving credit where it's due. Open source thrives on trust and acknowledgment, and overlooking that can lead to bigger issues down the line. Let’s remember to maintain integrity and always give credit to the hard work behind the code we use every day. 🖥️ Keep the dev community strong by valuing each other's contributions!
